name: family/kovee-host-effect-binding
description: The frozen portable_public host-effect binding fragment a consuming host publishes for execution_permit_consume (R3-L01, disposition D-R3-3), recorded from kovee's own producer. It is the converse of family/parent-budget-fragment: the VERIFIER (byom) must not derive its own expectation, so byom's shipped test consumes these exact recorded bytes. Of the nine members, byom holds six in its committed ActIntent (intent_ref, stable_execution_key, both manifest pairs), takes host_effect_ref from the request, and is handed external_idempotency_key and final_provider_request_typed_byte_digest — which are tied to each other by external_idempotency_key == kovee-model-{stable_execution_key}-{final_provider_request_typed_byte_digest[0:16]}.
